All done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (error rate ~18%).

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed the release history — v2.3.1 was unhealthy; the most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after completing us-east only); the retry succeeded across **us-east, us-west, and eu-west**.
3. Verified recovery: the service is now **healthy in all regions** on v2.3.0, with the error rate down from ~18% to ~0.2%.
4. Opened a **SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failure and the rollback. The creation call reported a timeout, but I confirmed the incident was successfully created and is open — the on-call engineer has been paged once (no duplicate).
